segments.displayText: Here is the plan for the cafe shoot we are filming today.
segments.verbatimText: Here is the plan for the cafe shoot we are filming today.

segments.displayText: First we set the scene so you can see exactly what the camera sees.

segments.displayText: Then we cut the whole tape down to one short vertical clip for the feed.

segments.displayText: After that the captions were burned in and checked against the audio.
